descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-15 Ask AI · S24 Existing chromium specs: Ask opens from Hospital Pre-Round and every NH tab; Ask waits for the complete dictated question

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T2 Ask About This Patient is reachable from all three tabs (Pre-Round, Encounter, Post-Round). (TFA-92593 AC 2)
  • U8 Works in both Hospital and Nursing Home contexts (ground rule 3.3). (UAT 3.3; TFA-92593 AC 9)
  • U3 A dictated custom question is answered correctly. (UAT TC-15; TFA-92593 AC 5)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given e2e/ask-ai.spec.ts and e2e/dictation-completion.spec.ts (speech mocked)

When Run the four titles

Then The sheet opens with the right preset on Hospital Pre-Round and on NH Pre-Round / Encounter / Post-Round ('What meds were changed?' on Post-Round); a dictated question is asked only once its final words arrive, in both contexts

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): The existing assertions. Real-mic transcription and a grounded answer stay in S20

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S24 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-15.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Test issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92593 ready for qa

Nothing is wrong for the physician here. The spec looks for a button named exactly 'Ask AI', but once text is typed the button reads 'Ask AI →'.

Evidence: Allure b49c507d, test out of date (local). The assertion comes from Tim's 5d83248 and fails against AskModal.tsx:257. dictation-completion.spec.ts fails toBeDisabled twice. Bisect shows 5d83248 is not a regression.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-15 Ask AI · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-15/S24

Existing chromium specs: Ask opens from Hospital Pre-Round and every NH tab; Ask waits for the complete dictated question

Tickets: TFA-92593 Ask AI (ready for qa)

Result: failed in matrix/TC-15.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Test out of date (local) — the test is out of date, the product is right; not a product failure.

  • dictation-completion.spec.ts:41 / :49: An assertion from Tim's 5d83248: once text is typed the button reads "Ask AI →" (AskModal.tsx:257), so an exact match on "Ask AI" never matches. The test is wrong, the product is right.

Bisected on an isolated stack over 7f3907f^, 5d83248^ and 5d83248: 5d83248 brought no regression.

Existing specs:

  • ask-ai.spec.ts [chromium] — Ask AI opens from the hospital Pre-Round tab — expected
  • ask-ai.spec.ts [chromium] — Ask AI opens from every nursing-home tab — expected
  • dictation-completion.spec.ts [chromium] — hospital: Ask AI waits for the complete dictated question — unexpected
  • dictation-completion.spec.ts [chromium] — nursing-home: Ask AI waits for the complete dictated question — unexpected

Failure screenshots and page snapshots are on the failing steps. Videos stay in matrix/TC-15-artifacts/ (not attached).

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's chromium specs e2e/ask-ai.spec.ts and e2e/dictation-completion.spec.ts): they make a fresh @roundai.test account and seed through e2e/support/backend.ts with the local admin key; dev has no admin key and one shared account, so they run on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
